body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Sony has leak some specs of the netbook 'Vaio Pocket' from their official website(www.sonyinsider.com), which is expected to be unveiled at the upcoming CES 2009.

Powered by Intel Atom 1.33GHz processor, the Vaio Pocket adopts a 8-inch LED backlit display with 1600x768 resolution. Running on Windows Vista OS, it will have the option of either a 60GB HDD or a 120GB SSD.
